Corning Incorporated is a materials science and technology company developing innovations across glass, ceramics, and related markets. The Engineer, Software Developer supports the Model Operations Development Engineering team by designing, developing, testing, deploying, and supporting software tools, web applications, backend services, user-facing applications, and data-driven solutions for scientific research and innovation.
Manufacturing
No H1B
Responsibilities
Participate in the full software development lifecycle, including requirements gathering, design, development, testing, and deployment
Develop and maintain backend services and REST APIs using Python frameworks such as Django or Flask
Contribute to frontend development using modern JavaScript frameworks such as Vue.js or React
Work with relational databases to support application functionality and data-driven features
Collaborate with scientists, engineers, and cross-functional teams to translate technical needs into software solutions
Support application troubleshooting, enhancements, and continuous improvement efforts
Participate in Agile workflows, code reviews, and development best practices

Required
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field; or equivalent experience
Experience building software or web applications through coursework, internships, co-ops, or project work
Foundational experience with object-oriented programming, preferably in Python
Familiarity with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or similar
Experience using Git or other version control tools
Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills
Ability to learn quickly and contribute in a team-based development environment
This position does not support immigration sponsorship
Preferred
Experience with Django or Flask for backend development
Familiarity with frontend frameworks such as Vue.js or React
Exposure to Docker or containerization concepts
Familiarity with Agile methodologies such as Scrum or Kanban
Internship, co-op, research, or project experience in a collaborative technical environment
Benefits
Company-wide bonuses and long-term incentives align with key business results and ensure you are rewarded when the company performs well.
100% company-paid pension benefit with fixed contributions that grow throughout your career.
Matching contributions to Corning’s 401(k) savings plan; Corning’s total contributions to retirement accounts can reach between 7% and 12% of pay, depending on age and years of service.
